body_markdown:
On 26 August, Captain Bill Lambden was presented with Hafnia’s Long Service Award in Singapore by Ralph Juhl, EVP, Technical, in recognition of an extraordinary 40-year career that has spanned three company names, dozens of vessels, and countless voyages across the world’s oceans.


To mark the occasion, Captain Lambden reflects in the below interview on a career that began, almost by accident, on the docks of Hong Kong.


The full interview can be read[here.](https://hafnia.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/5/2026/09/40-Years-at-Sea-Captain-Bill-Lambden-4.pdf)
